newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank vice chair says Sweden should join EMU.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank vice chair says Sweden should join EMU.

text.p: Sweden ought to join the European Union's currency union EMU, the vice chairman of Sweden's central bank, Bengt Westerberg, said on Tuesday.
Westerberg, quoted in Swedish daily newspaper Dagens Nyheter, said the nation's Finance Minister Erik Asbrink has been too passive in the debate and should be clearer about what he really thinks.
His comments were in-line with criticism made earlier by Riksbank chairman Kjell-Olof Feldt.
Westerberg, formerly leader of the Liberal Party, said if Asbrink thinks EMU membership is good for Sweden he should say so, but he is trying to avoid drawing a line.
Westerberg told Dagens Nyheter that in his opinion the beneficial economic reasons to join EMU outweighed the disadvantages.
Even if Asbrink did not want to tie Sweden into the EMU at the start in January 1999, it must happen.
